section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes a single study of college women testing interpersonal (e.g., attachment, caregiver eating messages) and intrapersonal (e.g., adaptive and maladaptive perfectionism) predictors of body appreciation and links to intuitive eating and depressive symptoms. Body appreciation mediated relations between maladaptive perfectionism, attachment anxiety, and restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages and intuitive eating, but did not uniquely predict depressive symptoms when other predictors were included. The section does not report sample size, country, BMI assessment, instrument for body appreciation, or correlations between BMI and body appreciation.
